title: CapabilityManifest
description: What an MCP server declares about itself at connect. This is the version-negotiation payload (M7): the host compares majors and REFUSES AT CONNECT rather than failing at first call, because an incompatibility discovered mid-conversation is a bad experience and a confusing bug report.

compatibility.notes: `contract_version` is the negotiated field and its semantics are frozen: MAJOR mismatch refuses at connect, MINOR mismatch connects. Changing that rule is MAJOR. `requires_network` gained meaning from ADR-0007 and is required, not optional — a server that does not declare it cannot be admitted at L0, and defaulting it to false would let a network-dependent server silently break offline conformance.

contract_version.description: Which CONTRACT SET this server speaks (contracts/MANIFEST.json). Not the server's own version.

requires_network.description: ADR-0007. TRUE EXCLUDES THIS SERVER FROM TIER L0, enforced by the L0 conformance gate. Required rather than defaulted: a silent default is how offline operation erodes.

placement.description: ADR-0005. host_only for anything touching physical devices or the local filesystem — those components cannot move regardless of tier.

tools.description: Full ToolSpec per tool. THE REGISTRY REJECTS ANY TOOL MISSING side_effect OR trust_required (ADR-0012, ADR-0026) — incomplete metadata is a registration failure, not a warning.

examples.name: system
examples.description: Read-only host telemetry: CPU, memory, disk, battery, GPU.

tools.name: system.get_disk_usage
tools.description: Report free and total disk space for a mounted volume on this machine. Use when the user asks about storage, free space, or whether something will fit. Does not delete or move anything.
